output.question: What are Amazon's subsidiaries?
output.answer: Amazon's latest SEC-filed Exhibit 21.1 (for the year ended December 31, 2025) lists these significant subsidiaries, each 100% owned: Amazon.com Services LLC, Amazon.com Sales, Inc., Amazon Data Services, Inc., Amazon Web Services, Inc., Amazon Technologies, Inc., Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, Amazon US Services LLC, A100 ROW, Inc., and Day One Insurance, Inc. [Source: SEC Exhibit 21.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000004/amzn-20251231xex211.htm) The filing gives Delaware as the jurisdiction for the first four and Amazon US Services LLC and A100 ROW, Inc.; Nevada for Amazon Technologies, Inc. and Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC; and Arizona for Day One Insurance, Inc.
